title: European Research Council's €10 million positive-geometries initiative
summary: Donald Hoffman tells of European Research Council's €10 million positive-geometries initiative, about present (2026) at Europe, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: It's so big now that the European Research Council has a 10 million euro initiative.

plain: Donald Hoffman, a scientist speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, describes "positive geometries", a new branch of mathematical physics associated with the physicist Nima Arkani-Hamed. He says the field has grown so big that the European Research Council, Europe's main public funder of science, now has a 10 million euro initiative devoted to it. He offers this as a sign that the ideas behind it are being taken seriously by mainstream science.
